ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/cream) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. The central region, extending from the fluke base to the medial sections of both lobes, is characterized by uniform low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude variations, characterized by multiple sharp peaks and narrow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to narrow, pointed distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white circular clusters located at the extreme terminal tips of both lobes, indicative of localized surface disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe and central dark field, oriented horizontally and diagonally across the pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tips of both lobes show irregular, jagged edges and uneven pigmentation, suggesting physical trauma or tissue erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular spot is positioned centrally within the white pigmentation field of the left distal lobe.
